purpose: Isolated painted parts for articulated gait. Generated with imagegen using prior character stills as references.

entries.prompt:
Edit this existing game character into a CUTOUT ANIMATION PUPPET PARTS ATLAS for real articulated walking. Preserve its identity, outfit, colors, polished painted mobile-game style, and approachable non-grotesque character design: a charcoal-gray rat game monster with pink ears, small bronze collar, a curled tail and a cute determined expression. Strict right-facing SIDE PROFILE so the walk can be animated. Square large canvas with three isolated pieces and very wide empty gutters.
LEFT 60%: one complete head, torso, full curled tail, collar as a SINGLE BODY PIECE. Absolutely NO legs or feet attached below the body. The underside ends cleanly; this is a toy animation component, not an injury.
UPPER RIGHT 35%: one entire FRONT LEG, from rounded upper attachment through elbow to paw. Its upper/lower segments extend STRAIGHT DOWN in neutral vertical alignment, with paw pointing right; no walking pose or horizontal bend.
LOWER RIGHT 35%: one entire HIND LEG from rounded upper attachment through knee to paw. Also STRAIGHT VERTICAL, foot pointing right. Foreleg and hind leg anatomically appropriate for a stylized quadruped.
Each leg is about half the HEIGHT of the body piece. Clean isolated cutouts, entire pieces inside canvas, no overlap, no floor, no shadow, no labels, no borders, no symbols. Real transparent background if supported, otherwise plain white. NO photorealism, gore, wounds, exposed organs or horror texture. Keep game-character proportions and soft silhouettes. This is a parts atlas, NOT a sheet of complete character poses.
